name: Payment Instruction 47
definition: Provides details on the payment instruction.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the original initiating party, to unambiguously identify the original payment transaction message|Usage: this is the former TransactionReference.

RequestedExecutionDate.name: Requested Execution Date
RequestedExecutionDate.definition: Date and time at which the cash is at the disposal of the credit account owner, or ceases to be at the disposal of the debit account owner.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Detailed information about the status of a transfer.||.

InstructedAmount.name: Instructed Amount
InstructedAmount.definition: Amount of money to be moved between the debtor and creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency as ordered by the initiating party.

InterbankSettlementAmount.name: Interbank Settlement Amount
InterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Underlying reason for the payment transaction.

PaymentMethod.name: Payment Method
PaymentMethod.definition: Indicates the message or event from which an instruction has been initiated.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Urgency or order of importance that the originator would like the recipient of the payment instruction to apply to the processing of the payment instruction.|.

ProcessingValidityTime.name: Processing Validity Time
ProcessingValidityTime.definition: Date and time range within which the payment instruction must be processed.|.

InstructionCopy.name: Instruction Copy
InstructionCopy.definition: Copy of the original instruction, in free form text.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type, or nature, of the payment, such as express payment.|.

GeneratedOrder.name: Generated Order
GeneratedOrder.definition: Payment is a liquidity transfer order that has been executed automatically following a predefined or standing order.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the first instructing agent, to unambiguously identify the transaction that is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire interbank chain.|Usage: The transaction identification can be used for reconciliation, tracking or to link tasks relating to the transaction on the interbank level. The instructing agent has to make sure that the transaction identification is unique for a pre-agreed period.|Usage: This is the former PaymentInstructionReference.

InterbankSettlementDate.name: Interbank Settlement Date
InterbankSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

EndToEndIdentification.name: End To End Identification
EndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the initiating party, to unambiguously identify the transaction. This identification is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire end-to-end chain.|Usage: The end-to-end identification can be used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the transaction.|It can be included in several messages related to the transaction.|Usage: This is the former related reference.

Parties.name: Parties
Parties.definition: Defines the party fields used to search for a payment.
